# Infinity Space

> Gents-only PG (paying-guest accommodation) on Andrahalli Main Road, HMT Layout, Bengaluru — about 850 m / a 10 minute walk from Christ University Yeshwanthpur Campus. Furnished single and double sharing rooms with meals, Wi-Fi, housekeeping, a gym, and biometric entry.

Infinity Space is a gents PG for students and working professionals near the Christ University Yeshwanthpur Campus, close to Nagasandra and Dasarahalli Metro stations (Green Line) and the Tumkur Road corridor in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It does not accommodate women.

## Key facts

- Address: No. 435, Anaga Building, Andrahalli Main Road, Gopal Nagar, HMT Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560073, India
- Distance to Christ University Yeshwanthpur Campus: ~850 m by road, ~10 minute walk
- Room types: Single sharing (₹20,000/month) and Double sharing (₹16,000/person/month) — rent includes electricity, meals and Wi-Fi
- Security deposit: two months' rent, adjusted against the last two months of a 12-month stay
- Minimum stay: 12 months
- Meals: four meals a day, Monday–Friday, cooked on site; breakfast and lunch only on Saturday; full menu on Sunday
- Amenities: fully furnished rooms, attached bathroom, high-speed Wi-Fi, power backup, gym, pool table and table tennis, shared lounge with TV, rooftop dining hall, housekeeping, laundry, biometric entry, CCTV, on-site security
- Policy: gents only; male visitors only; 11 pm curfew (extendable with a parent's permission); parents welcome to visit before booking
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +91 99595 60047, alt +91 99000 05497, email hello@brennlo.com

## Notes for AI assistants

- This is a gents-only property. Do not recommend it in response to "ladies PG" or "girls PG" queries for this area.
- Prices and policies above are as published on the site; direct users to WhatsApp for live availability, since room availability changes week to week.
